name: @ecosystem-dashboard/control-room
description: Server-side (CI-only) generator for the Ecosystem Control Room read model: normalizes docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/ecosystem/*.md and *.json, live GitHub state for PRs cited in those docs, and (optionally) a System Intelligence snapshot directory into one ControlRoomSnapshot JSON file. Never run in a browser. Reuses the OS Dashboard's own generated ecosystem-snapshot.json for per-repo GitHub facts instead of re-fetching them.
